package core

type ParamSet map[string]any

func (ParamSet) Int(key string, fallback int) int { return fallback }

func (ParamSet) Severity(fallback int) int { return fallback }

type AnalyzerConfig struct {
	Enabled bool
	Params  map[string]any
}

type AnalysisConfig struct{ Analyzers map[string]AnalyzerConfig }

type AnalysisContext struct{ Config *AnalysisConfig }

func (AnalysisContext) Params(id string) ParamSet                             { return ParamSet{} }
func ExtensionFilter(ctx AnalysisContext, id string, extra []string) []string { return extra }
